value.rationale: The nonzero optimizer jump at a sharp favorable-year frequency, persistent local dormancy metastability, and contrasting inverse-square-root versus reciprocal critical-frequency scaling are structural effects of cooperative positive returns, not a reparameterization of linear bet hedging. The exact result is useful as a benchmark for comparing facilitation mechanisms suggested by documented empirical discrepancies, while making no prediction of field demography or ecological management.
